publications.title: Enhanced Compression Model (ECM): A Hyperprior-Based Neural Image Compression Framework
publications.venue: IEEE Xplore, presented at INSTCon 2026, NIT Rourkela
publications.description: Extended a Scale Hyperprior VAE architecture with semantic gating, channel attention, autoregressive context modelling, an entropy parameter network, and scale refinement. Achieved **0.176 BPP**, **30.882 dB PSNR**, and **0.985 MS-SSIM** on the Kodak benchmark, outperforming the Scale Hyperprior baseline and classical codecs (JPEG, WebP) at comparable or lower bitrates.
